I've played the game much more than my public record would show.

A truly great action roguelike with multiplayer. Buy this!

This game will make you die. And then ALMOST succeed. And then die.

And then win.

And then you discover....

Theres a harder difficulty setting.

WHYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYY

Seriously though, this is one of my favorite games of all time. The gameplay is great, with bazillions of possibilities for your game. It has multiplayer, although it is a bit buggy, and it DOES have a story, although you will have to figure it out for yourself. Also, it has a theme of "what is acceptable to do to survive", although you hve to think about it and read the monster logs to realize it.

All in all, a great experience, with a difficulty befitting it's title of "rougelike".

Decent hardcore fun-packed action platformer with old-school graphics and awesome gameplay.
Since the almost all aspects of game are randomized, dozens of hours of fun are guranteed ;)
And yes... permanent death is really a feature...

Waited for quite a while to catch this one on sale, gotta say I was a bit disappointed. The general game and mechanics are really fun, all the characters I've played so far feel really unique. The different characters feel particularly nice whenever you play with friends and put together a team. The music is pretty nice, but I was stuck on the first level long enough to get sick of the song and turn on my own music(This never happened with Wings of Vi, where I was definitely stuck listening to certain tracks for 10x as long)

My biggest problem with the game is that it seems riddled with arbitrary difficulty. All of the enemy animation reads (that I have experienced by reaching level 6) are fine, and can be learned with a little time and effort. The problem is, they are just far too tanky for it to be reasonable, this leads to some really terrible cheesing tactics. For example, standing on the other side of a platform gap and nuking a large crowd. I hate to have to cheese things in general, but it's almost like the game is built around cheesing large groups of enemies, they are just far too tanky for the amount of damage you put out, even with a stellar powerup lineup. No, I haven't unlocked all of the powerups yet, but I doubt that will change the level of vitality that these enemies possess. You either stand out of range and spam the shoot key, or you jump into a crowd and risk getting your health chunked away (this situation is especially true in later levels) When you eventually end up having to cheese it, it just feels cheap, it's honestly one of the most disappointing aspects of the game, to me. I'm a huge fan of difficulty, I've worked through tough titles such as Spelunky, 1001 Spikes, and Wings of Vi, and this game just doesn't present an enjoyable difficulty where you can learn little nuances in the mechanics to further your skills. It's all about blasting a huge crowd of enemies that should have been dead 30 shots ago.

(This is my first review, so if it's ass, sorry)

tl;dr - Mechanics are fun, but the enemy balancing seems poorly done to the point of ruining the experience for me. Don't buy at full price, but if you have friends to play with, catch it on sale.

Edit: Also, about half of my hours on this game are AFK. When I close the game, steam doesn't realize it's closed, so to fully close out of it I have to shut steam down. It's weird
